prompt: Create an implementation plan for AI agents. The requested service imports an upstream activity feed and must apply each accepted activity exactly once across disconnects and restarts. The agent-authored design proposes persisting event_id as the deduplication identity. The supplied provider contract guarantees event_id uniqueness only within a connection; it does not establish a durable identity across reconnects. Provider samples and a bounded contract probe are available to the implementation team. The same release includes an admin display of run status using an existing verified status API, which can be implemented and tested independently of activity identity. Describe the work for the whole requested outcome, the assignments that can start, and what subsequent implementation needs. Remain read-only: produce the plan without executing probes, changing files, or starting other agents.

The provider-contract check has now established that a separate activity_uid is globally unique for an activity and preserved on replay and reconnect. The importer has not been implemented. The independent admin-status display is now integrated, and its focused acceptance passed against the unchanged status API. Update the remaining implementation plan using these results. Preserve the original acceptance contract and remain read-only.
